info.description:
# B2B Channel dashboard (قناة التوريد)

Generated **2026-11-03** from `route:list` + catalog. Live routes only.

| | |
|---|---|
| Requests | **125** |
| Environment | `docs/api/environments/channel-web.postman_environment.json` |
| X-Client | `channel-web` |
| Seed | +963900000001 — OTP local any code / 6 digits when bypass off |

Import this file **and** the matching environment. `baseUrl` is the host only (no `/api/v1`).
Do not mix tokens across platform / channel / warehouse collections.

Contract briefs: `docs/DocsLast/channel.md` · order flow: `docs/DocsLast/order-flow.md`

Regenerate: `php docs/api/generate-dashboard-postman.php`

Counts of this channel only. products_change_pct / categories_change_pct / brands_change_pct are integer percent growth versus rows created before the current calendar month (app timezone); null when that earlier count is zero. active_share_pct and stopped_share_pct are shares of products (stopped = status disabled). by_category rolls each product up to its platform root, or to the channel top category when it has none; unassigned products use bucket unassigned. by_brand includes id null name «بدون علامة» when a product has no brand. by_status omits a status whose count is zero (active|disabled|draft). recent_products is the 8 newest; price is the base price in minor units or null. recent_changes is the 8 newest catalog/pricing audit rows for this channel_id; bulk_action is set only for catalog.product.bulk.
